verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own docs include a first-party path for connecting coding tools via Nexus CLI, with a choice of Fireworks models or Nexus Auto (docs-59), and the site markets it for AI coding workloads (docs-11). However, the pack names no specific coding agents and shows no integration guides for agent frameworks. OpenAI compatibility and tool calling are building blocks, not integration guides. Missing for 10: named per-agent setup guides (e.g., specific coding agents), first-party guides for agent frameworks, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Nexus CLI integration.
